title: Tal Takes f7
setup: Tal against Tringov, Amsterdam 1964. Black's king has not castled, and nothing but the king guards f7.
hint: The king alone guards f7. Where does it end up if it has to take, with your queen already on d6?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxf7+}} gives the bishop for the pawn the king alone was guarding, and it forces mate. After {{Kxf7}} {{Ng5+}} the king has to step back to e8, because the queen and knight cover every other square, and {{Qe6+}} mates within two moves whatever Black plays: Tringov resigned there.

The king never castled, so f7 was the one door in, and White's queen, knight and bishop were all within reach of it.
